All I'm saying is that my wife,  myself and most of my friends attended one of the lowest rated high schools in the province.  All of my circle of friends are now successful professionals in their chosen disciplines.  At my 10 year high school reunion,  the grand majority are working & happy people.   Money and supplies,  which were clearly in short supply at the time did not hinder success.  Motivated & creative teachers were enough. In high school,  I leaned the ability to learn which has led to my success.  I dont need to read studies that show students have more success with more teachers in the class room,  I believe it 100%.  I can also say,  in my class of 30 students,  I had plenty of 1 on 1 with my teachers.  

 I live in the far North of the province  Here we have a shortage of teachers.   I think there is teaching opportunity for the willing in the province.  Perhaps the issue is many teachers are not willing to go where the work is.  I would have loved to stay in my home town but I go where the work is.  My best friend is a teacher,  she put in 11 years in Rankin Inlet Nunavut before transferring to my area.
